{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Number of unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Duplicate patient_id count: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {(df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()}")

# Check for assay_batch unit error
print(f"Unique assay_batch values: {df['assay_batch'].unique()}")

# Check arm distribution
print(f"Arm distribution: {df['arm'].value_counts().to_dict()}")

# Check sex distribution in treatment arm
print(f"Sex distribution in treatment arm: {df[df['arm'] == 'treatment']['sex'].value_counts().to_dict()}")

# Check if sex is balanced in treatment arm
sex_in_treatment = df[df['arm'] == 'treatment']['sex'].value_counts()
print(f"Sex balance in treatment arm: {sex_in_treatment.to_dict()}")"}
